modern: Observe what your nature requires, so far as you are governed by nature only: then do it and accept it, if your nature, so far as you are a living being, will not be made worse by it. And next you must observe what your nature requires so far as you are a living being. And all this you may allow yourself, if your nature, so far as you are a rational animal, will not be made worse by it. But the rational animal is consequently also a political, that is, a social, animal. Use these rules, then, and trouble yourself about nothing else.

And all this thou mayst allow thyself, if thy nature, so far as thou art a rational animal, shall not be made worse by it. But the rational animal is consequently also a political [social] animal.
